ctx.x: All right. I'm in the first class which Agry COLA, which is a fan MR. PUELLA, PUELLA, I don't like (unintelligible) girl and boy, Latin. What the hell I need with Latin? What -- I'm not going to be a doctor. And she's -- that's my first period class. And I'm not lying to you. And they sent a message in there, please release Arnett Cobb to come down and rehearse with the stage band. And she said, Arnett Cobb, you are excused to go down to the auditorium for rehearsal with the band. I said, 'Thank you,' and they…
Well, now, Arnett, going from C melody to tenor, that wasn't as simple as that, was it?
